title: Successful restore leaves cached VPN decisions stale
reproduction: New Context/URI cases warm application model then restore opposite rule; held shared lease and source guard reject without mutation and allow retry; malformed and SQLite failure cases release ownership.
expected: Success follows committed rule reconciliation and completed runtime sync/invalidation; busy gives explicit retry feedback; no autoenable or root write.
observed: Baseline missing invalidation was source-confirmed. Main phase-two log records all six new Context/URI cache and ownership cases passing with the VPN stopped.
fix: Shared lease encloses SourceModel.runSourceMutation plus AppDatabase transaction and syncHostEntries; cache invalidates on post-commit rebuild failure; typed busy exception maps to retry text; no apply/start calls.
test_evidence: Six new Android cases passed in main phase two; 22 related host tests passed again after test-fixture correction. No held-maintenance failure injection or real backup-transport proof. Main owns integration and device gates.

title: Successful exports can exceed the importer's hard limits
reproduction: Host boundaries exercise 200/201 counts and 50000/50001 aggregate rules plus formatted-character limit; new Android cases export 200 sources and preserve sentinel output for 201 or invalid/oversized content.
expected: Every successfully generated export meets shared import validation; over-limit export fails before destination open/truncation; hostile-input caps stay unchanged.
observed: Shared validation and exact serialization checks pass host tests. Main phase two passed 200-source roundtrip and 201/invalid-row sentinel checks; oversized fixture hit SQLite CursorWindow before serialization and is corrected pending rerun.
fix: Move unchanged limits and full-row parsing into BackupFormat; exporter validates generated object and pretty-printed length before openOutputStream; importer reuses parser and bounded read constant.
test_evidence: Five new host tests passed within 22-test backup suite after correction. Three Android cases passed; corrected fourth compiles but awaits Android rerun. Fixture now distributes 16777400 label characters over 200 readable rows and requires exact size-guard cause plus unchanged sentinel. No production or cap changes in follow-up.

title: Restore silently ignores saved settings for existing source URLs
reproduction: New Room cases restore existing label/selection with stable source and rule IDs; change allow format or revoke redirect trust; insert new URL; inject later database failure; try reserved user-source document.
expected: Restore permitted metadata/selection while preserving identity and safe existing content; changed formats invalidate old rows/validators; redirect trust stays false; atomic rollback and reserved user source remain protected.
observed: Main phase-two log records all six new Room cases passing. Reserved-source rejection also has passing host coverage.
fix: Exact-URL reconciliation updates existing row in place; propagate changed selection only; preserve unrelated metadata; format/trust changes clear source/stage rows and HTTP metadata through existing APIs; reject user-source URL before writes.
test_evidence: Six new Android cases passed in main phase two; reserved-source host regression passed again. No DAO/schema changes and no downloads or scheduling side effects added. No root runtime proof claimed.

title: IPv6 and monitor switches save values without updating the active VPN
reproduction: New actual-switch cases toggle monitor and IPv6 on/off across recreation and require replacement workers/tunnels; separate stopped-VPN/root controls assert no service launch.
expected: Post-persistence changes reconfigure the active VPN without starting stopped/root modes; rotation does not duplicate restarts.
observed: Main phase two passed the actual-switch stopped-VPN/root suppression case. Both live reconfiguration cases skipped without opt-in. Shared controller still sends START and cross-command concurrent STOP ordering is unchanged.
fix: Observe relevant persisted preference changes with fragment-owned listeners; route through existing restart only for selected VPN plus isRunning; remove old pre-persistence bypass/system-exclusion callbacks; unregister onDestroy.
test_evidence: One Android case passed; two skipped without adawayLiveVpnSmoke and prepared consent. Live worker/tunnel behavior remains unverified; IPv6 DNS-family assertions require dual-stack upstream otherwise replacement tunnel still required. No persistence-only success claim or shared controller/service changes.
